changelog: Tested every declared preference against its runtime reader; the exact inventory of unimplemented keys is now pinned by a regression test.
Added first tests for the install-mode resolver, notification blur policy and Discord custom-data resolution.
Verified shared-value contracts never contradict how a key is stored; no phantom key may be read as a setting.
Removed the last interactive control that stored a value nothing reads (Stream Quality).
message: Preference reader audit and new runtime contract tests
